scope: Full core free-beta release: initial scope through worldwide AWS rollout and post-launch operation.

status_definitions.L: Bounded feature/deliverable exists and is supported by inspected source or recorded local verification. Does not mean production deployed.
status_definitions.P: Some source, implementation or local checks exist; material scope or acceptance is incomplete.
status_definitions.R: Runnable definition, test harness or workflow is authored but the actual relevant execution is not recorded. External runtime dependencies are listed separately.
status_definitions.B: A concrete execution stage or owner input is unavailable/failed. Some also depend on unfinished assistant-owned code.
status_definitions.N: Specific deliverable or production-scope acceptance has not started; assistant-owned code is not marked blocked just for lack of AWS access.

counting_rules: Each core task has one primary status. Dependencies/blocker flags do not create extra task counts.
Different deliverables, such as implementing a feature and executing its production acceptance, are tracked explicitly.
This is a new detailed decomposition of the release plan; do not add the older 24 broad areas or the CP-01 20-task batch to these counts.
Equal-sized count marks represent tasks, not effort, elapsed time, production readiness or percent of the project completed.
Eight conditional domain/payment tasks are outside the 112-task free-beta denominator.
